title_zh: MUSE-Autoskill：通过技能创建、记忆、管理与评估实现自我进化的智能体
one_line: Agent creates skills from its own trajectories, gates them by unit tests or sandbox checks, and refines, merges, prunes a skill bank with per-skill memory.
one_line_zh: 智能体从自身轨迹创建技能，经单元测试或沙箱检查把关，并对技能库做修订、合并与剪枝，同时维护每个技能的经验记忆。

held_out.quote: each self-created skill is generated from one successful Phase 1 trajectory and re-evaluated on the same task

cross_task.quote: We inject skills created by Codex, Claude Code, and MUSE-Autoskill into Hermes without task-specific modification, and evaluate Hermes on the 75-task common set.

variance.quote: MUSE-Autoskill-created skills have the lowest run-to-run reward dispersion among the compared self-created-skill conditions

budget_matched.quote: We evaluate four agents, all using GPT-5.5 as the backbone model

optimizer_cost.quote: Token traces are incomplete across runtimes, so token-cost results are diagnostic.

retained_ablation.quote: MUSE-Autoskill obtains the largest gain and the strongest self-created result, improving from 46.95% to 53.42%

leakage_guard.quote: no task-specific ground truth is fed into the skill

evidence_level.quote: each self-created skill is generated from one successful Phase 1 trajectory and re-evaluated on the same task

S1.quote: existing skill creation approaches often treat skills as isolated, static artifacts, limiting reusability, reliability, and long-term improvement

S2.quote: each self-created skill is generated from one successful Phase 1 trajectory

S3.quote: For code-backed skills, the strongest signal comes from unit tests when the package contains a tests/ directory.

S4.quote: the system supports maintenance of the skill bank through three mechanisms: refinement , merging , and pruning

S5.quote: the system runs those tests inside the sandbox and blocks registration until they pass

F2.quote: skills should not be one-off generation outputs but long-lived, evolving assets of an agent system

F5.quote: For code-backed skills, the strongest signal comes from unit tests when the package contains a tests/ directory.

title_zh: ESC-Skills：发现并自我进化情感支持对话技能
one_line: Induces emotional-support skills from annotated successful and failed dialogues, then refines the skill bank via simulated-seeker interaction analysis and simulation-based verification.
one_line_zh: 从成功与失败的情感支持对话标注中归纳技能，再通过模拟求助者交互分析与仿真验证来迭代精炼技能库。

held_out.quote: by evaluating on the official test split containing 195 emotional support conversations

cross_task.quote: we have not yet validated it on other supportive dialogue settings

retained_ablation.quote: The final refined bank achieves the best overall performance across both benchmarks.

code.quote: We will release the code, prompts, and ESC-Skills Bank at https://github.com/aliyun/qwen-dianjin

evidence_level.quote: On the dialogue-level SAGE benchmark, ESC-Skills consistently improves the long-horizon support performance of most LLM backbones.

S1.quote: skills induced from static corpora may contain incomplete guidance or hidden failure patterns

S2.quote: Based on IUs extracted from both successful and failed ESC dialogues

S3.quote: The analyzer determines whether the interventions facilitate constructive emotional transitions or instead lead to problematic outcomes such as withdrawal, agitation, confusion, or invalidation.

S4.quote: Similar recommendations are consolidated by Claude-Opus to merge semantically overlapping update reasons and cluster near-duplicate skill proposals.

S5.quote: candidate skill refinements and newly proposed skills are validated through simulation-based verification

F2.quote: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to develop a self-evolving executable skill framework for ESC.

F5.quote: Based on IUs extracted from both successful and failed ESC dialogues

title_zh: 更好的经验：面向循证健康社区笔记的自进化大模型智能体

one_line_zh: 评判器按健康传播质量给每条笔记生成轨迹打分，记忆演化器把分阶段、带触发条件的策略写入记忆供后续检索，模型权重保持冻结。

title_zh: FederatedSkill：面向智能体技能进化的联邦学习
one_line: Clients evolve local skill libraries and upload only skill patches; a server evolution agent models each client's capability boundary and issues personalized library updates.
one_line_zh: 各客户端本地演化技能库并只上传技能补丁，服务端演化智能体据此建模每个客户端的能力边界并下发个性化库更新。

held_out.quote: Following each round, the agent uses its past trajectories and reward signals to update its skill library.

cross_task.quote: agents are initialized with an empty skill library and must tackle the tasks within each family sequentially

optimizer_cost.quote: achieving up to a 44.4% increase in success rate and a 37.5% reduction in computational cost

evidence_level.quote: FederatedSkill increases the average task success rate from 37.4% to 45.8%

S1.quote: impose a uniform global library that fails to accommodate client heterogeneity

S3.quote: Each trajectory is then evaluated by the environment to assign a verification reward

S4.quote: cross-client deduplication , which merges semantically similar skills from disparate clients into a unified abstraction

F5.quote: Each trajectory is then evaluated by the environment to assign a verification reward

title_zh: EpiEvolve：面向疫情体制变化下流式大流行预测的自进化智能体
one_line: Frozen epidemic forecaster stores outcomes in hierarchical episodic memory, reflects on delayed labels, and distills recurring errors into predicate rules retrieved by regime-aware similarity.
one_line_zh: 冻结的疫情预测模型把预测结果存入分层情景记忆，依据延迟到达的标签反思，并把反复出现的错误提炼成谓词规则。

held_out.quote: A method must issue forecasts using only information available at that week, and it may update its state after the corresponding labels arrive.

cross_task.quote: hospitalization trend classification is not a full epidemiological forecasting task

budget_matched.quote: All methods obey the delayed feedback protocol and share the same backbone (except Claude-ICL and CDC)

retained_ablation.quote: The largest accuracy drop comes from removing reflection, which leaves no textual lesson to retrieve and also disables the strategic distiller

leakage_guard.quote: following a chronological protocol that prevents future leakage

evidence_level.quote: EpiEvolve reaches $0.629$ average accuracy, compared with $0.561$ for the static backbone

S1.quote: it enables a frozen epidemic LLM backbone to adapt through hierarchical episodic memory

S3.quote: EpiEvolve treats delayed forecast errors after deployment as the primary signal for adaptation.

S4.quote: obsolete rules are demoted but not deleted

S5.quote: rules whose preconditions match with confidence above a threshold are rendered into the <RULES> slot

F1.quote: can therefore substitute for retraining the backbone in this streaming hospitalization-trend setting

F2.quote: To our knowledge, EpiEvolve is the first self-evolving LLM agent for streaming epidemic forecasting under regime shifts.

F3.quote: prompt and memory adaptation can match or exceed explicit parameter updates while leaving the backbone weights immutable

F5.quote: EpiEvolve treats delayed forecast errors after deployment as the primary signal for adaptation.

title_zh: Skill-3D：为智能体3D空间推理演化场景感知技能
one_line: Rollouts fill a Scene Memory; successes distill into scene-aware skills, failures attach as lessons, a Skill Manager gates inserts, merges and patches; skills guide post-training.
one_line_zh: 轨迹写入场景记忆，成功经验蒸馏为场景感知技能、失败作为教训附着，技能管理器对插入、合并、补丁做把关，技能再用于后训练。

title_zh: TabClaw：面向电子表格操作与表格推理的交互式自进化智能体
one_line: ReAct table agent distills recurring tool sequences from completed workflows into user-approved skills and revises skills from negative feedback.
one_line_zh: ReAct 表格智能体把已完成工作流中反复出现的工具序列蒸馏为用户批准的技能，并依据负面反馈修订技能。

S3.quote: Recurring successful patterns can be distilled into reusable skills, while negative feedback provides evidence for revising skills that repeatedly fail.
